mundane.text: You studied hard all year. Your knowledge expanded.
You caught a serious virus and stayed in the hospital.
You found a good part-time job and saved up some dollars.
Your boss turned out to be a disguised low-tier demon! You broke his printer, got fined, but tempered your spirit.
You accidentally bought a 'glowing rock' on the darknet. It was radioactive ore. Health dropped, but you feel a strange energy.

secret.text: You stumbled upon a hidden spiritual vein in an old park. Qi energy fills you.
During night meditation, a severe Mana Burn occurred. Your meridians are damaged.
You helped a stray dog that turned out to be a guardian spirit. Your karma improved.
Street thugs who turned out to be rogue cultivators cornered you. You fought them off with the 'Iron Wind Palm' and took their cash.
